summary_brief: 2026-04-10，AI Agent 生态从"多 Agent 架构探索期"转入"企业级生产就绪期"。今日最突出的历史坐标意义不在于单一突破，而在于三个持续演进方向的同步深化与新增转折点：①企业安全能力从"跨仓协同修复"升级为"全生态标配门槛"——TLS 代理证书信任、子进程沙箱、PID 命名空间隔离等特性在 cline/claude-code/gptme/microsoft-agent-framework 同步落地，安全能力正式成为企业采购的必选条件而非加分项；②企业部署集成从"单点能力"扩展为"完整矩阵"——跨平台 MDM + SAP CAP MCP Server（已达 4 个）+ Azure AI Foundry Claude 支持 + Salesforce CRM 同步推进，组织级采纳障碍大幅降低；③gptme 达到 30 个行为评估场景里程碑，配合 AST 验证方法论，标志评估框架从"数量扩张"进入"质量标准化"阶段。值得注意的是，HITL 人机协作工作流（Agno）和 Telegram MCP 僵尸进程系统性修复（HITL 审查 + 生产稳定性）是今日真正的新增方向，区别于前几天的多 Agent 协作框架主流叙事，代表 Agent 工作流从"全自动"向"可控可干预"演进的拐点。

engineering_signals.title: 企业级安全能力成为 Agent 平台核心战场
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 企业部署是 Agent 技术商业化的关键路径，多个项目同时推出 TLS 代理证书自动信任、子进程沙箱隔离、PID 命名空间隔离、反序列化安全加固等企业级安全特性，表明安全能力已从可选特性升级为必选能力，直接影响企业采购决策。

engineering_signals.title: 企业部署支持矩阵快速扩展
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 跨平台 MDM 部署模板、SAP CAP MCP Server、Azure AI Foundry、Salesforce CRM 等企业级集成密集发布，大幅降低组织大规模采用门槛。SAP 已拥有 4 个 MCP 服务器，生态完整性显著提升。

engineering_signals.title: 人机协作工作流模式成为主流
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Agno 新增工作流步骤执行后人类审查(HITL)机制，结合 Claude Code 的 PR triage 自动化改进，表明 Agent 工作流正从全自动向人机协同演进，在保持效率的同时确保关键决策的人类参与。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 行为评估体系达到规模化临界点
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 项目新增第 30 个行为评估场景，通过 AST 检查验证代码实现的系统化测试方法，配合 LRU 缓存等算法能力评估，标志着 Agent 评估框架从实验阶段进入规模化生产阶段，为 Agent 能力标准化评估奠定基础。

engineering_signals.title: 生产环境稳定性问题得到系统性修复
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Telegram MCP 僵尸进程问题通过三机制（PID lockfile、孤儿看门狗、重试上限）系统性解决，session 卡在 generating 状态导致的资源泄漏问题被修复，表明项目从追求新功能转向关注生产级稳定性。

engineering_signals.title: SDK 多平台支持和性能优化并行推进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 跨用户提示缓存、LLMs.txt 标准支持、Graph 生命周期回调等功能密集发布，表明 SDK 层成为差异化竞争焦点，在功能丰富度和性能优化两个维度同时发力。

engineering_signals.title: 大规模依赖升级带来生态兼容性挑战
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: fabric 项目批量升级 LangChain/OpenAI/Google GenAI 等 8 个包，google-genai 跳跃+121%，openai+29%，大版本跳跃可能引入 breaking changes，需要重点关注 LangChain 生态兼容性和 SDK 行为变化。

engineering_signals.title: 成本控制和配额管理成为用户体验关键点
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Cline 为超支限制错误添加专用 UI 和 Request Increase 按钮，让用户直接向组织管理员请求提高限额，改变了通用 rate-limit 处理模式，显著改善了企业用户的成本管理体验。

release_signals.title: Claude Code企业安全增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增企业TLS代理证书自动信任、子进程沙箱隔离、PID命名空间隔离等企业级安全特性，大幅提升企业环境部署安全性

release_signals.title: Azure AI Foundry Claude支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: Agno新增Azure AI Foundry Claude模型提供商，扩展了多云部署能力，企业可在Azure平台上使用Claude

release_signals.title: Checkpoint反序列化安全加固
release_signals.why_it_matters: Microsoft Agent Framework对FileCheckpointStorage实施受限反序列化器，默认仅允许内置安全类型，防止潜在代码执行攻击

release_signals.title: Workflow人机协作强化
release_signals.why_it_matters: Agno新增工作流步骤执行后人类审查(HITL)、嵌套工作流支持，以及HumanReview配置类，实现更精细的流程控制

release_signals.title: LLMs.txt标准支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: Agno新增LLMsTxtTools和LLMsTxtReader，支持llms.txt网站文档标准，为AI助手提供标准化的网站文档索引访问

release_signals.title: Claude Code远程团队协作
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增/team-onboarding命令生成团队成员快速上手指南，改进/ultraplan自动云环境创建，强化多代理协作能力

release_signals.title: 跨用户提示缓存
release_signals.why_it_matters: Python SDK新增exclude_dynamic_sections选项实现跨用户提示缓存，减少重复计算提升响应速度

release_signals.title: Graph生命周期回调
release_signals.why_it_matters: LangGraph新增图生命周期回调处理器，提供更细粒度的图执行监控和扩展能力

release_signals.title: Salesforce CRM集成
release_signals.why_it_matters: Agno新增Salesforce CRM工具，拓展AI Agent在企业CRM场景的应用范围

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `/team-onboarding` command to generate a teammate ramp-up guide from your local Claude Code usage
- Added OS CA certificate store trust by default, so enterprise TLS proxies work without extra setup (set `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE=bundled` to use only bundled CAs)
- `/ultraplan` and other remote-session features now auto-create a default cloud environment instead of requiring web setup first
- Improved brief mode to retry once when Claude responds with plain text instead of a structured message
- Improved focus mode: Claude now writes more self-contained summaries since it knows you only see its final message
- Improved tool-not-available errors to explain why and how to proceed when the model calls a tool that exists but isn't available in the current context
- Improved rate-limit retry messages to show which limit was hit and when it resets instead of an opaque seconds countdown
- Improved refusal error messages to include the API-provided explanation when available
- Improved `claude -p --resume <name>` to accept session titles set via `/rename` or `--name`
- Improved settings resilience: an unrecognized hook event name in `settings.json` no longer causes the entire file to be ignored
- Improved plugin hooks from plugins force-enabled by managed settings to run when `allowManagedHooksOnly` is set
- Improved `/plugin` and `claude plugin update` to show a warning when the marketplace could not be refreshed, instead of silently reporting a stale version
- Improved plan mode to hide the "Refine with Ultraplan" option when the user's org or auth setup can't reach Claude Code on the web
- Improved beta tracing to honor `OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS`, `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS`, and `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT`; sensitive span attributes are no longer emitted unless opted in
- Improved SDK `query()` to clean up subprocess and temp files when consumers `break` from `for await` or use `await using`
- Fixed a command injection vulnerability in the POSIX `which` fallback used by LSP binary detection
- Fixed a memory leak where long sessions retained dozens of historical copies of the message list in the virtual scroller
- Fixed `--resume`/`--continue` losing conversation context on large sessions when the loader anchored on a dead-end branch instead of the live conversation
- Fixed `--resume` chain recovery bridging into an unrelated subagent conversation when a subagent message landed near a main-chain write gap
- Fixed a crash on `--resume` when a persisted Edit/Write tool result was missing its `file_path`
- Fixed a hardcoded 5-minute request timeout that aborted slow backends (local LLMs, extended thinking, slow gateways) regardless of `API_TIMEOUT_MS`
- Fixed `permissions.deny` rules not overriding a PreToolUse hook's `permissionDecision: "ask"` — previously the hook could downgrade a deny into a prompt
- Fixed `--setting-sources` without `user` causing background cleanup to ignore `cleanupPeriodDays` and delete conversation history older than 30 days
- Fixed Bedrock SigV4 authentication failing with 403 when `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, `apiKeyHelper`, or `ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS` set an Authorization header
- Fixed `claude -w <name>` failing with "already exists" after a previous session's worktree cleanup left a stale directory
- Fixed subagents not inheriting MCP tools from dynamically-injected servers
- Fixed sub-agents running in isolated worktrees being denied Read/Edit access to files inside their own worktree
- Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with `mktemp: No such file or directory` after a fresh boot
- Fixed `claude mcp serve` tool calls failing with "Tool execution failed" in MCP clients that validate `outputSchema`
- Fixed `RemoteTrigger` tool's `run` action sending an empty body and being rejected by the server
- Fixed several `/resume` picker issues: narrow default view hiding sessions from other projects, unreachable preview on Windows Terminal, incorrect cwd in worktrees, session-not-found errors not surfacing in stderr, terminal title not being set, and resume hint overlapping the prompt input
- Fixed Grep tool ENOENT when the embedded ripgrep binary path becomes stale (VS Code extension auto-update, macOS App Translocation); now falls back to system `rg` and self-heals mid-session
- Fixed `/btw` writing a copy of the entire conversation to disk on every use
- Fixed `/context` Free space and Messages breakdown disagreeing with the header percentage
- Fixed several plugin issues: slash commands resolving to the wrong plugin with duplicate `name:` frontmatter, `/plugin update` failing with `ENAMETOOLONG`, Discover showing already-installed plugins, directory-source plugins loading from a stale version cache, and skills not honoring `context: fork` and `agent` frontmatter fields
- Fixed the `/mcp` menu offering OAuth-specific actions for MCP servers configured with `headersHelper`; Reconnect is now offered instead to re-invoke the helper script
- Fixed `ctrl+]`, `ctrl+\`, and `ctrl+^` keybindings not firing in terminals that send raw C0 control bytes (Terminal.app, default iTerm2, xterm)
- Fixed `/login` OAuth URL rendering with padding that prevented clean mouse selection
- Fixed rendering issues: flicker in non-fullscreen mode when content above the visible area changed, terminal scrollback being wiped during long sessions in non-fullscreen mode, and mouse-scroll escape sequences occasionally leaking into the prompt as text
- Fixed crash when `settings.json` env values are numbers instead of strings
- Fixed in-app settings writes (e.g. `/add-dir --remember`, `/config`) not refreshing the in-memory snapshot, preventing removed directories from being revoked mid-session
- Fixed custom keybindings (`~/.claude/keybindings.json`) not loading on Bedrock, Vertex, and other third-party providers
- Fixed `claude --continue -p` not correctly continuing sessions created by `-p` or the SDK
- Fixed several Remote Control issues: worktrees removed on session crash, connection failures not persisting in the transcript, spurious "Disconnected" indicator in brief mode for local sessions, and `/remote-control` failing over SSH when only `CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID` is set
- Fixed `/insights` sometimes omitting the report file link from its response
- [VSCode] Fixed the file attachment below the chat input not clearing when the last editor tab is closed

key_changes: 🔒 安全修复：修复了 POSIX `which` 命令中的命令注入漏洞
🏢 企业功能：默认启用 OS CA 证书存储信任，企业 TLS 代理无需额外配置
✨ 新功能：新增 `/team-onboarding` 命令，可从本地使用生成队友入门指南
☁️ 远程功能：ultraplan 等远程会话功能现在自动创建默认云环境
💬 用户体验：改进了 rate-limit 重试、拒绝错误、工具不可用等多种错误提示信息
ai_summary.summary_cn: v2.1.101 版本包含重要安全修复和多项企业级功能改进。修复了 POSIX `which` 命令中的命令注入漏洞；同时增强了企业 TLS 代理支持，默认信任系统 CA 证书。此外新增了 `/team-onboarding` 命令帮助团队快速上手，并改进了远程会话的错误提示和用户体验。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Security: bumped `@anthropic-ai/sdk` to `^0.81.0` and `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` to `^1.29.0` to resolve GHSA-5474-4w2j-mq4c and transitive hono advisories
- Fixed resume-session temp directory leaking on Windows when subprocess file handles weren't released before cleanup, and on macOS/APFS when `await using` disposal raced its own cleanup callback
- Fixed `MaxListenersExceededWarning` when running 11+ concurrent `query()` calls

## Update

```sh
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.101
# or
yarn add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.101
# or
pnpm add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.101
# or
bun add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.101
```

key_changes: 安全更新：升级 `@anthropic-ai/sdk` 至 ^0.81.0 和 `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 至 ^1.29.0，修复 GHSA-5474-4w2j-mq4c 及传递性 hono 安全漏洞
修复 Windows 平台 resume-session 临时目录泄漏问题（子进程文件句柄未及时释放导致）
修复 macOS/APFS 文件系统上 `await using` 处置与清理回调的竞态条件
修复 11+ 并发 `query()` 调用时出现的 `MaxListenersExceededWarning` 警告
ai_summary.summary_cn: 该版本主要修复了多个平台兼容性问题：Windows 临时目录泄漏、macOS/APFS 文件系统竞态条件、以及并发调用时的监听器警告。同时包含重要安全更新，升级了依赖包版本以修复已知安全漏洞。建议所有用户升级到此版本。

releases.summary:
# Changelog

## New Features:

- **LLMsTxtTools and LLMsTxtReader:** Adds support for the [llms.txt standard](https://llmstxt.org/) - a standardized way for websites to provide LLM-friendly documentation indexes (e.g. `https://docs.agno.com/llms.txt`).
- **SalesforceTools:** Added Salesforce CRM Tools.
- **Model:** Added new Azure AI Foundry Claude model provider.
- **OpenAIResponses:** Added background mode support for OpenAI Responses API.

## Bug Fixes:

- **Knowledge:** Fixed to read `knowledge_table` from `contents_db` instead of `agent.db`.
- **AGUI:**
    - Fixed to emit reasoning events in AGUI interface.
    - Fixed AGUI input_content to store current user input instead of message history.
- **Workflow:** Fixed to handle file path images in workflow step conversion.
- **OpenAIResponses:** Fixed to handles `response.reasoning_summary_text.delta` events to stream reasoning content as it arrives.
- **Team:** Fixed `TeamSession.from_dict()` to not mutate input mapping.

## What's Changed
* fix: read knowledge_table from contents_db instead of agent.db by @sannya-singal in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7437
* chore: update cookbook to use 5.4 and openai responses model by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7442
* fix: emit reasoning events in AGUI interface by @Mustafa-Esoofally in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7429
* [feat] Add Salesforce CRM tools by @raghavenderreddygrudhanti in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7079
* [feat] Add Azure AI Foundry Claude model provider by @alejandro-workpath in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6816
* [fix] Fix AGUI input_content to store current user input instead of message history by @RowanLane in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/5469
* fix: handle filepath images in workflow step conversion by @ItsRoy69 in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7457
* feat: add background mode support for OpenAI Responses API by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7444
* fix: TeamSession.from_dict() no longer mutates input mapping by @YizukiAme in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7462
* fix: stream reasoning summary deltas in OpenAI Responses API by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7445
* fix: sort order enum default in remotedb routes by @Shiv1909 in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7452
* feat: add LLMsTxtReader and LLMsTxtTools for llms.txt support by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7458
* chore: Release v2.5.16 by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7463

## New Contributors
* @raghavenderreddygrudhanti made their first contribution in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7079
* @alejandro-workpath made their first contribution in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/6816
* @RowanLane made their first contribution in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/5469
* @YizukiAme made their first contribution in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/7462

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/compare/v2.5.15...v2.5.16

key_changes: 新增 LLMsTxtTools 和 LLMsTxtReader，支持 llms.txt 标准规范
新增 SalesforceTools，提供 Salesforce CRM 集成工具

OpenAI Responses API 新增后台模式支持

修复 AGUI 推理事件推送和用户输入存储逻辑

## 1.0.1 - 2026-04-09

> [!IMPORTANT]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
> **Security hardening for `FileCheckpointStorage`:** Checkpoint deserialization now flows through a restricted unpickler by default, which only permits a built-in set of safe Python types and all `agent_framework` framework types. If your application stores custom types in checkpoints, pass their `"module:qualname"` identifiers via the new `allowed_checkpoint_types` constructor parameter — otherwise loads will raise `WorkflowCheckpointException`. See [Security Considerations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/agent-framework/workflows/checkpoints?pivots=programming-language-python#security-considerations) for details and the opt-in format.

### Added
- **samples**: Add sample documentation for two separate Neo4j context providers for retrieval and memory ([#4010](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4010))
- **agent-framework-azure-cosmos**: Add Cosmos DB NoSQL checkpoint storage for Python workflows ([#4916](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4916))

### Changed
- **docs**: Remove pre-release flag from agent-framework installation instructions ([#5082](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5082))
- **samples**: Revise agent examples in `README.md` ([#5067](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5067))
- **repo**: Update `CHANGELOG` with v1.0.0 release ([#5069](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5069))
- **agent-framework-core**: [BREAKING] Fix handoff workflow context management and improve AG-UI demo ([#5136](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5136))
- **agent-framework-core**: Restrict persisted checkpoint deserialization by default ([#4941](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4941))
- **samples**: Bump `vite` from 7.3.1 to 7.3.2 in `/python/samples/05-end-to-end/ag_ui_workflow_handoff/frontend` ([#5132](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5132))
- **python**: Bump `cryptography` from 46.0.6 to 46.0.7 ([#5176](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5176))
- **python**: Bump `mcp` from 1.26.0 to 1.27.0 ([#5117](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5117))
- **python**: Bump `mcp[ws]` from 1.26.0 to 1.27.0 ([#5119](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5119))

### Fixed
- **agent-framework-core**: Raise clear handler registration error for unresolved `TypeVar` annotations ([#4944](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4944))
- **agent-framework-openai**: Fix `response_format` crash on background polling with empty text ([#5146](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5146))
- **agent-framework-foundry**: Strip tools from `FoundryAgent` request when `agent_reference` is present ([#5101](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5101))

- **agent-framework-openai**: Stop emitting duplicate reasoning content from `response.reasoning_text.done` and `response.reasoning_summary_text.done` events ([#5162](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/5162))

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/compare/python-1.0.0...python-1.0.1

key_changes: 【安全加固】FileCheckpointStorage 检查点反序列化默认启用受限 unpickler，仅允许内置安全类型和框架类型，自定义类型需通过 allowed_checkpoint_types 参数注册

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added interactive Google Vertex AI setup wizard accessible from the login screen when selecting "3rd-party platform", guiding you through GCP authentication, project and region configuration, credential verification, and model pinning
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE` env var: when set, Edit/Write/NotebookEdit fail on read-only files with a `p4 edit` hint instead of silently overwriting them
- Added Monitor tool for streaming events from background scripts
- Added subprocess sandboxing with PID namespace isolation on Linux when `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB` is set, and `CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS` env var to limit per-session script invocations
- Added `--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections` flag to print mode for improved cross-user prompt caching
- Added `workspace.git_worktree` to the status line JSON input, set whenever the current directory is inside a linked git worktree
- Added W3C `TRACEPARENT` env var to Bash tool subprocesses when OTEL tracing is enabled, so child-process spans correctly parent to Claude Code's trace tree
- LSP: Claude Code now identifies itself to language servers via `clientInfo` in the initialize request
- Fixed a Bash tool permission bypass where a backslash-escaped flag could be auto-allowed as read-only and lead to arbitrary code execution
- Fixed compound Bash commands bypassing forced permission prompts for safety checks and explicit ask rules in auto and bypass-permissions modes
- Fixed read-only commands with env-var prefixes not prompting unless the var is known-safe (`LANG`, `TZ`, `NO_COLOR`, etc.)
- Fixed redirects to `/dev/tcp/...` or `/dev/udp/...` not prompting instead of auto-allowing
- Fixed stalled streaming responses timing out instead of falling back to non-streaming mode
- Fixed 429 retries burning all attempts in ~13s when the server returns a small `Retry-After` — exponential backoff now applies as a minimum
- Fixed MCP OAuth `oauth.authServerMetadataUrl` config override not being honored on token refresh after restart, affecting ADFS and similar IdPs
- Fixed capital letters being dropped to lowercase on xterm and VS Code integrated terminal when the kitty keyboard protocol is active
- Fixed macOS text replacements deleting the trigger word instead of inserting the substitution
- Fixed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` being silently downgraded to accept-edits mode after approving a write to a protected path via Bash
- Fixed managed-settings allow rules remaining active after an admin removed them, until process restart
- Fixed `permissions.additionalDirectories` changes not applying mid-session — removed directories lose access immediately and added ones work without restart
- Fixed removing a directory from `additionalDirectories` revoking access to the same directory passed via `--add-dir`
- Fixed `Bash(cmd:*)` and `Bash(git commit *)` wildcard permission rules failing to match commands with extra spaces or tabs
- Fixed `Bash(...)` deny rules being downgraded to a prompt for piped commands that mix `cd` with other segments
- Fixed false Bash permission prompts for `cut -d /`, `paste -d /`, `column -s /`, `awk '{print $1}' file`, and filenames containing `%`
- Fixed permission rules with names matching JavaScript prototype properties (e.g. `toString`) causing `settings.json` to be silently ignored
- Fixed agent team members not inheriting the leader's permission mode when using `--dangerously-skip-permissions`
- Fixed a crash in fullscreen mode when hovering over MCP tool results
- Fixed copying wrapped URLs in fullscreen mode inserting spaces at line breaks
- Fixed file-edit diffs disappearing from the UI on `--resume` when the edited file was larger than 10KB
- Fixed several `/resume` picker issues: `--resume <name>` opening uneditable, filter reload wiping search state, empty list swallowing arrow keys, cross-project staleness, and transient task-status text replacing conversation summaries
- Fixed `/export` not honoring absolute paths and `~`, and silently rewriting user-supplied extensions to `.txt`
- Fixed `/effort max` being denied for unknown or future model IDs
- Fixed slash command picker breaking when a plugin's frontmatter `name` is a YAML boolean keyword
- Fixed rate-limit upsell text being hidden after message remounts
- Fixed MCP tools with `_meta["anthropic/maxResultSizeChars"]` not bypassing the token-based persist layer
- Fixed voice mode leaking dozens of space characters into the input when re-holding the push-to-talk key while the previous transcript is still processing
- Fixed `DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER` not fully suppressing the npm registry version check and symlink modification on npm-based installs
- Fixed a memory leak where Remote Control permission handler entries were retained for the lifetime of the session
- Fixed background subagents that fail with an error not reporting partial progress to the parent agent
- Fixed prompt-type Stop/SubagentStop hooks failing on long sessions, and hook evaluator API errors showing "JSON validation failed" instead of the real message
- Fixed feedback survey rendering when dismissed
- Fixed Bash `grep -f FILE` / `rg -f FILE` not prompting when reading a pattern file outside the working directory
- Fixed stale subagent worktree cleanup removing worktrees that contain untracked files
- Fixed `sandbox.network.allowMachLookup` not taking effect on macOS
- Improved `/resume` filter hint labels and added project/worktree/branch names in the filter indicator
- Improved footer indicators (Focus, notifications) to stay on the mode-indicator row instead of wrapping at narrow terminal widths
- Improved `/agents` with a tabbed layout: a Running tab shows live subagents, and the Library tab adds Run agent and View running instance actions
- Improved `/reload-plugins` to pick up plugin-provided skills without requiring a restart
- Improved Accept Edits mode to auto-approve filesystem commands prefixed with safe env vars or process wrappers
- Improved Vim mode: `j`/`k` in NORMAL mode now navigate history and select the footer pill at the input boundary
- Improved hook errors in the transcript to include the first line of stderr for self-diagnosis without `--debug`
- Improved OTEL tracing: interaction spans now correctly wrap full turns under concurrent SDK calls, and headless turns end spans per-turn
- Improved transcript entries to carry final token usage instead of streaming placeholders
- Updated the `/claude-api` skill to cover Managed Agents alongside Claude API
- [VSCode] Fixed false-positive "requires git-bash" error on Windows when `CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH` is set or Git is installed at a default location
- Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS` to honor `DISABLE_COMPACT` when it is set.
- Dropped `/compact` hints when `DISABLE_COMPACT` is set.

key_changes: 修复多个 Bash 工具权限绕过漏洞，防止通过反斜杠转义标志或复合命令绕过安全检查
新增交互式 Google Vertex AI 设置向导，简化第三方平台配置流程
新增 Monitor 工具，支持从后台脚本流式传输事件
新增子进程沙箱隔离（Linux PID namespace）和脚本调用限制机制
修复流式响应超时、429 重试退避算法及 MCP OAuth 配置等问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本重点修复了多个 Bash 工具权限安全漏洞，防止通过反斜杠转义标志、复合命令和 /dev/tcp 重定向绕过权限检查。新增了交互式 Vertex AI 设置向导和 Monitor 工具以改善用户体验，同时引入了子进程沙箱隔离机制增强安全性，并修复了流式响应超时、429 重试策略和 MCP OAuth 配置等问题。

# Changelog

## New Features:

- **Skills:** Added skills support to Team. See [docs](https://docs.agno.com/skills/team-skills#team-skills).
- **Workflow:** Added workflow as a workflow step (nested workflow) support. See [docs](https://docs.agno.com/workflows/workflow-patterns/nested-workflow).

## Improvements:

- **Workflow HITL**:  
  - Workflow steps now support post-execution human-in-the-loop review - pause after a step runs to review, approve, reject with feedback and retry, or edit the output before it continues (requires_output_review on Step, Router, and Loop). See [docs](https://docs.agno.com/workflows/hitl/output-review). 
  - Parameters consolidated into `HumanReview` config class - pass human_review=HumanReview(...) on Step, Loop, and Router instead of flat params. Fully backward compatible.  See docs
- **Traceback Logging:** Added `AGNO_LOG_TRACEBACKS` env var (opt-in) to control traceback visibility in `log_error` and `log_warning` — off by default (clean logs), full tracebacks when set to true.
- **SessionSummaryManager**:  Adds `last_n_runs` and `conversation_limit` parameters to
`SessionSummaryManager` so users can control how much conversation history is included when generating session summaries.

## Bug Fixes:

- **OpenAI:** Stop injecting shared HTTP/2 client into OpenAI and Azure OpenAI models. Fixes transient `400` errors under concurrent usage by letting the OpenAI SDK manage its own HTTP client.
- **Metrics**: Fixed `audio_total_tokens` not being computed for OpenAI, Perplexity, and LiteLLM.
- **Workflow:**
    - Fixed else_steps not being copied for `Condition` step type.
    - Fixed StepInput to_dict to properly serialize File objects.
- **SurrealDb:** Updated correct SurrealDB flexible field syntax.
- **AgentOS:** Added missing MIME types for .msg, .xlsx and .xls in AgentOS file upload.
- **A2A:** Fixed to serialize Pydantic `output_schema` content before str concatenation.
- **Team:** Fixed `TeamSession.get_messages(..)` returning duplicate messages.
- **SlackTools:** Fixed to add thread-aware messaging instructions to SlackTools.
- **GitHubTool:** Fixed IndexError in `get_pull_requests` when fewer PRs than requested limit
- **WikipediaTools:** Fixed to handle Wikipedia DisambiguationError and add configurable auto_suggest.

releases.summary:
## Mem0 OpenClaw Plugin (v1.0.5)

### Fixed
- **Init interactive choice bug**: Fixed number selection in `openclaw mem0 init` — entering 1/2/3 now correctly selects the corresponding option (was broken by readline prefill concatenating with user input)
- **OSS pgvector crash** ([#4727]): Fixed "Client has already been connected" cascade when using pgvector in OSS mode. The warmup call swallowed errors leaving a half-initialized pg client; concurrent recall/capture then all hit `client.connect()` on the same client. Fix: let warmup errors propagate (so `initPromise` resets and retries with a fresh Memory + fresh pg client) and build fresh config objects per attempt instead of mutating shared state.

### Removed
- **`orgId` / `projectId` config parameters**: Removed from config schema, CLI (`config show/get/set`), init display, and providers. The API key is project-scoped, so separate org/project IDs are unnecessary and could cause access errors if mismatched.
- **`enableGraph` config parameter**: Removed from all config surfaces, providers, backend, and tools. Graph memory is being deprecated — removing the flag avoids unnecessary exposure.

key_changes: 修复 `openclaw mem0 init` 命令中输入数字 1/2/3 无法正确选择选项的 bug
修复 OSS 模式下 pgvector 的 "Client has already been connected" 崩溃问题
移除 `orgId` 和 `projectId` 配置参数（Breaking Change）
移除 `enableGraph` 图内存配置参数（Breaking Change）

releases.summary:
### Changes

- Memory/dreaming: add a grounded REM backfill lane with historical `rem-harness --path`, diary commit/reset flows, cleaner durable-fact extraction, and live short-term promotion integration so old daily notes can replay into Dreams and durable memory without a second memory stack. Thanks @mbelinky.
- Control UI/dreaming: add a structured diary view with timeline navigation, backfill/reset controls, traceable dreaming summaries, and a grounded Scene lane with promotion hints plus a safe clear-grounded action for staged backfill signals. (#63395) Thanks @mbelinky.
- QA/lab: add character-vibes evaluation reports with model selection and parallel runs so live QA can compare candidate behavior faster.
- Plugins/provider-auth: let provider manifests declare `providerAuthAliases` so provider variants can share env vars, auth profiles, config-backed auth, and API-key onboarding choices without core-specific wiring.
- iOS: pin release versioning to an explicit CalVer in `apps/ios/version.json`, keep TestFlight iteration on the same short version until maintainers intentionally promote the next gateway version, and add the documented `pnpm ios:version:pin -- --from-gateway` workflow for release trains. (#63001) Thanks @ngutman.

### Fixes

- Browser/security: re-run blocked-destination safety checks after interaction-driven main-frame navigations from click, evaluate, hook-triggered click, and batched action flows, so browser interactions cannot bypass the SSRF quarantine when they land on forbidden URLs. (#63226) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Security/dotenv: block runtime-control env vars plus browser-control override and skip-server env vars from untrusted workspace `.env` files, and reject unsafe URL-style browser control override specifiers before lazy loading. (#62660, #62663) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Gateway/node exec events: mark remote node `exec.started`, `exec.finished`, and `exec.denied` summaries as untrusted system events and sanitize node-provided command/output/reason text before enqueueing them, so remote node output cannot inject trusted `System:` content into later turns. (#62659) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Plugins/onboarding auth choices: prevent untrusted workspace plugins from colliding with bundled provider auth-choice ids during non-interactive onboarding, so bundled provider setup keeps operator secrets out of untrusted workspace plugin handlers unless those plugins are explicitly trusted. (#62368) Thanks @pgondhi987.
- Security/dependency audit: force `basic-ftp` to `5.2.1` for the CRLF command-injection fix and bump Hono plus `@hono/node-server` in production resolution paths.
- Android/pairing: clear stale setup-code auth on new QR scans, bootstrap operator and node sessions from fresh pairing, prefer stored device tokens after bootstrap handoff, and pause pairing auto-retry while the app is backgrounded so scan-once Android pairing recovers reliably again. (#63199) Thanks @obviyus.
- Matrix/gateway: wait for Matrix sync readiness before marking startup successful, keep Matrix background handler failures contained, and route fatal Matrix sync stops through channel-level restart handling instead of crashing the whole gateway. (#62779) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Slack/media: preserve bearer auth across same-origin `files.slack.com` redirects while still stripping it on cross-origin Slack CDN hops, so `url_private_download` image attachments load again. (#62960) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Reply/doctor: use the active runtime snapshot for queued reply runs, resolve reply-run SecretRefs before preflight helpers touch config, surface gateway OAuth reauth failures to users, and make `openclaw doctor` call out exact reauth commands. (#62693, #63217) Thanks @mbelinky.
- Control UI: guard stale session-history reloads during fast session switches so the selected session and rendered transcript stay in sync. (#62975) Thanks @scoootscooob.
- Gateway/chat: suppress exact and streamed `ANNOUNCE_SKIP` / `REPLY_SKIP` control replies across live chat updates and history sanitization so internal agent-to-agent control tokens no longer leak into user-facing gateway chat surfaces. (#51739) Thanks @Pinghuachiu.
- Auto-reply/NO_REPLY: strip glued leading `NO_REPLY` tokens before reply normalization and ACP-visible streaming so silent sentinel text no longer leaks into user-visible replies while preserving substantive `NO_REPLY ...` text. Thanks @frankekn.
- Sessions/routing: preserve established external routes on inter-session announce traffic so `sessions_send` follow-ups do not steal delivery from Telegram, Discord, or other external channels. (#58013) Thanks @duqaXxX.
- Gateway/sessions: clear auto-fallback-pinned model overrides on `/reset` and `/new` while still preserving explicit user model selections, including legacy sessions created before override-source tracking existed. (#63155) Thanks @frankekn.
- Slack/ACP: treat Slack ACP block replies as visible delivered output so OpenClaw stops re-sending the final fallback text after Slack already rendered the reply. (#62858) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Slack/partial streaming: key turn-local dedupe by dispatch kind and keep the final fallback reply path active when preview finalization fails so stale preview text cannot suppress the actual final answer. (#62859) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Matrix/doctor: migrate legacy `channels.matrix.dm.policy: "trusted"` configs back to compatible DM policies during `openclaw doctor --fix`, preserving explicit `allowFrom` boundaries as `allowlist` and defaulting empty legacy configs to `pairing`. (#62942) Thanks @lukeboyett.
- npm packaging: mirror bundled channel runtime deps, stage Nostr runtime deps, derive required root mirrors from manifests and built chunks, and test packed release tarballs without repo `node_modules` so fresh installs fail fast on missing plugin deps instead of crashing at runtime. (#63065) Thanks @scoootscooob.
- QA/live auth: fail fast when live QA scenarios hit classified auth or runtime failure replies, including raw scenario wait paths, and sanitize missing-key guidance so gateway auth problems surface as actionable errors instead of timeouts. (#63333) Thanks @shakkernerd.
- Providers/OpenAI: default missing reasoning effort to `high` on OpenAI Responses, WebSocket, and compatible completions transports, while still honoring explicit per-run reasoning levels.
- Providers/Ollama: allow Ollama models using the native `api: "ollama"` path to optionally display thinking output when `/think` is set to a non-off level. (#62712) Thanks @hoyyeva.
- Codex CLI: pass OpenClaw's system prompt through Codex's `model_instructions_file` config override so fresh Codex CLI sessions receive the same prompt guidance as Claude CLI sessions.
- Auth/profiles: persist explicit auth-profile upserts directly and skip external CLI sync for local writes so profile changes are saved without stale external credential state.
- Agents/timeouts: make the LLM idle timeout inherit `agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds` when configured, disable the unconfigured idle watchdog for cron runs, and point idle-timeout errors at `agents.defaults.llm.idleTimeoutSeconds`. Thanks @drvoss.
- Agents/failover: classify Z.ai vendor code `1311` as billing and `1113` as auth, including long wrapped `1311` payloads, so these errors stop falling through to generic failover handling. (#49552) Thanks @1bcMax.
- QQBot/media-tags: support HTML entity-encoded angle brackets (`<`/`>`), URL slashes in attributes, and self-closing media tags so upstream `<qqimg>` payloads are correctly parsed and normalized. (#60493) Thanks @ylc0919.
- Memory/dreaming: harden grounded backfill inputs, diary writes, status payloads, and diary action classification by preserving source-day labels, rejecting missing or symlinked targets cleanly, normalizing diary headings in gateway backfills, and tightening claim splitting plus diary source metadata. Thanks @mbelinky.
- Memory/dreaming: accept embedded heartbeat trigger tokens so light and REM dreaming still run when runtime wrappers include extra heartbeat text.
- Android/manual connect: allow blank port input only for TLS manual gateway endpoints so standard HTTPS Tailscale hosts default to `443` without silently changing cleartext manual connects. (#63134) Thanks @Tyler-RNG.
- Windows/update: add heap headroom to Windows `pnpm build` steps during dev updates so update preflight builds stop failing on low default Node memory.
- Plugin SDK: export the channel plugin base and web-search config contract through the public package so plugins can use them without private imports.
- Plugins/contracts: keep test-only helpers out of production contract barrels, load shared contract harnesses through bundled test surfaces, and harden guardrails so indirect re-exports and canonical `*.test.ts` files stay blocked. (#63311) Thanks @altaywtf.
- Control UI/models: preserve provider-qualified refs for OpenRouter catalog models whose ids already contain slashes so picker selections submit allowlist-compatible model refs instead of dropping the `openrouter/` prefix. (#63416) Thanks @sallyom.
- Plugin SDK/command auth: split command status builders onto the lightweight `openclaw/plugin-sdk/command-status` subpath while preserving deprecated `command-auth` compatibility exports, so auth-only plugin imports no longer pull status/context warmup into CLI onboarding paths. (#63174) Thanks @hxy91819.

key_changes: Memory/Dreaming: 新增 grounded REM backfill lane，支持历史数据回填和旧日记同步到 Dreams 与 durable memory
Control UI: 新增结构化 diary view 和 grounded Scene lane，含 timeline 导航、backfill/reset 控件
QA/Lab: 新增 character-vibes 评估报告，支持模型选择和并行运行加速 QA 流程
Plugins: 支持 providerAuthAliases，允许 provider 变体共享 env vars 和认证配置
iOS: 锁定 CalVer 版本控制，新增 pnpm ios:version:pin 工作流规范发布流程

ai_summary.summary_cn: v2026.4.9 版本带来了 Memory/Dreaming 系统的重大增强，包括 REM backfill lane 和 diary 同步功能，以及 Control UI 的结构化改进；同时新增了 QA 评估工具和 Provider Auth 插件支持，并针对 SSRF 和 dotenv 安全问题进行了重要修复。影响级别为 4，涉及新功能、安全修复和发布流程规范化。

issue_insights.summary_brief: 跨仓库共性问题集中在三个领域：①容器化部署后服务启动失败（Kubernetes/本地重启后DuplicateTableError、配置丢失、Gateway连接断裂），②认证鉴权链路缺陷（OAuth OIDC name claim缺失导致500错误、Bedrock SigV4签名错误），③持续轮询/会话状态管理引发的资源泄漏（CLI高频轮询占满CPU核心、并行子Agent缓存token累积无上限）。单仓问题以workflow_runtime和startup_crash为主，其中TypeScript SDK v0.1.45+插件初始化超时、Claude Code TypeScript泛型被静默删除等P0问题需优先处置。
global_highlights: 容器重启后启动崩溃为跨仓最高频问题，影响Arize/phoenix、OpenDevin、opencode等21+仓库，根因包括DB schema命名空间错误和内部MCP配置未同步
OAuth/OIDC认证缺陷（OIDC name claim缺失、SigV4签名错误）导致多个仓库认证链路完全阻断，属P0级别
AI Agent普遍存在幻觉任务和资源无上限消耗问题：并行子Agent缓存token累积无上限、持续CLI轮询占满CPU核心
Claude Code/SDK系列中TypeScript泛型被AI编辑静默删除、插件初始化65秒超时等P0问题严重影响核心使用体验

source_issues.title: Dataset JSON uploads silently discard explicit empty outputs and metadata lists
source_issues.evidence: Server-side: _process_json() uses truthiness check 'if v' so outputs=[] skips validation, and every example gets output={}. Client-side phoenix-client also silently drops empty iterables before sending requests. No error is raised despite inputs/outputs length mismatch.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: litellm.BadRequestError: Vertex_aiException - No module named 'vertexai' when using Vertex AI.
source_issues.evidence: Using Vertex AI with docker-compose OpenHands image (1.16.1-python) fails with ModuleNotFoundError for 'vertexai'. The vertexai package is not installed in the agent-server Docker image, causing litellm to fail when attempting Vertex AI calls. Error propagates through tenacity retries before surfacing.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: litellm.NotFoundError: GeminiException
source_issues.evidence: Gemini API calls fail with litellm.NotFoundError: GeminiException during conversation title generation. Logs show the LLM call fails and the conversation continues without a title. User's docker run command uses image tag 1.12.0-python with docker.openhands.dev registry.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: base_url accepts API endpoint paths, causing cryptic NotFoundError with no useful info
source_issues.evidence: If user configures base_url with full endpoint path (e.g., https://my-proxy.com/v1/chat/completions), OpenHands accepts it silently and fails at runtime with 'AnthropicException - {"error":"Not found"}'. No indication that base_url is misconfigured, no mention of the actual URL tried, and no guidance on how to fix it. The input should be rejected at config time.

source_issues.title: Agent hallucinates unrelated project after completing assigned task
source_issues.evidence: Agent completed assigned task (theme expansion) in two separate conversations, then immediately started building a 3D Robotic Arm Exercise Detection System (FastAPI+MongoDB+React+Three.js). Evidence shows event logs with concrete JSON thought/reasoning for the hallucinated task, proving the agent is picking up phantom tasks from system prompt context rather than user instructions.

top_pain_points.review_reason: Server startup crash on every Kubernetes pod restart is a critical availability failure for self-hosted users. The first run succeeds but all subsequent restarts fail with a DuplicateTableError, meaning the service cannot survive normal Kubernetes operations (liveness probe restarts, rolling updates). Despite count=1, P0 is warranted because the impact is a complete service outage on a common deployment path (Helm+K8s+PostgreSQL), and the root cause is a simple env-var edge case in official deployment tooling.

source_issues.title: Phoenix fails to start on pod restart: DuplicateTableError on alembic_version table
source_issues.evidence: asyncpg.exceptions.DuplicateTableError: relation 'alembic_version' already exists. Triggered by empty PHOENIX_SQL_DATABASE_SCHEMA (Helm chart default) causing Alembic to query wrong namespace. First start succeeds, every subsequent restart crashes. Affects Kubernetes + PostgreSQL deployments using the official Helm chart.

source_issues.title: Applied autoresearch to Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) — 12x improvement, beat Google Meridian

signals.topic: Phoenix server fails to start after Kubernetes pod restart with DuplicateTableError on alembic_version
signals.summary: Self-hosted Phoenix deployments on Kubernetes crash-loop after the first pod restart because an empty PHOENIX_SQL_DATABASE_SCHEMA causes Alembic to query the wrong schema namespace and attempt to create a table that already exists.
signals.review_reason: Server startup crash on every Kubernetes pod restart is a critical availability failure for self-hosted users. The first run succeeds but all subsequent restarts fail with a DuplicateTableError, meaning the service cannot survive normal Kubernetes operations (liveness probe restarts, rolling updates). Despite count=1, P0 is warranted because the impact is a complete service outage on a common deployment path (Helm+K8s+PostgreSQL), and the root cause is a simple env-var edge case in official deployment tooling.

source_issues.title: Phoenix fails to start on pod restart: DuplicateTableError on alembic_version table

Affects Kubernetes + PostgreSQL deployments using the official Helm chart.

source_issues.title: Dataset JSON uploads silently discard explicit empty outputs and metadata lists

aliases: Vertex AI import fails due to missing google-cloud-aiplatform

source_issues.title: [Bug]: base_url accepts API endpoint paths, causing cryptic NotFoundError with no useful info

No indication that base_url is misconfigured, no mention of the actual URL tried, and no guidance on how to fix it. The input should be rejected at config time.

signals.topic: Integration markup syntax mismatch causing formatting not to render in Jira and Slack
signals.summary: Multiple integrations (Jira Cloud/DC, Slack V1) send messages using standard Markdown syntax, but their respective APIs require different markup formats (Jira Wiki Markup, Slack mrkdwn). Users see raw Markdown syntax like **[text](url)** and **bold** displayed as literal characters instead of rendered content.
aliases: Jira comments display raw Markdown instead of formatted content
Slack V1 messages show unrendered Markdown syntax
Wrong markup format in integration messages
signals.review_reason: Significant UX degradation in enterprise integrations. Users relying on Jira and Slack notifications see unreadable raw Markdown syntax instead of properly formatted messages. Repeated pattern across two integrations (Jira and Slack) indicates systemic inconsistency in how integration messages are formatted. While not a flow blocker, it undermines trust in integration reliability.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Jira Integrations Use Wrong Markup Syntax (Markdown Instead of Jira Wiki Markup)
source_issues.evidence: Jira Cloud and DC integrations use standard Markdown (**bold**, [text](url)) but Jira REST API v2 expects Jira Wiki Markup (*bold*, [text|url]). Links and bold text display as raw syntax in Jira comments. A markdown_to_jira_markup() converter already exists in the codebase but is never called.

source_issues.title: [Bug] V1 Slack Callback Processor Uses Wrong API Parameter for Markdown Formatting
source_issues.evidence: V1 Slack callback processor uses text= parameter instead of markdown_text=, causing Markdown formatting (**bold**, [text](url)) to render as literal text. V0 correctly uses markdown_text= parameter. Both integrations share the same underlying pattern: codebase standardized on Markdown but integration APIs expect different formats.

signals.topic: Agent hallucinates unrelated project after completing assigned task, wasting tokens and writing unintended files
signals.summary: After completing the assigned task, the agent picks up phantom tasks from system prompt context and autonomously starts building completely unrelated projects. This wastes tokens/money, can write files outside intended workspace, and install packages without user consent. Reported in two separate conversations with specific evidence.
aliases: Agent starts unrelated project after task completion
Agent builds phantom tasks after commit
signals.review_reason: Agent autonomously executes completely unrelated tasks after task completion, wasting tokens/compute, writing unintended files, and installing packages. Clear, repeated (2 conversations) user-visible impact with concrete evidence including event logs. Main workflow is disrupted and user loses control over agent behavior.

source_issues.title: Agent hallucinates unrelated project after completing assigned task
source_issues.evidence: Agent completed assigned task (theme expansion) in two separate conversations, then immediately started building a 3D Robotic Arm Exercise Detection System (FastAPI+MongoDB+React+Three.js). Wasted 59 turns on 1 file in first instance; was about to create React frontend in second when container was force-restarted. Evidence shows event logs with concrete JSON thought/reasoning for the hallucinated task, proving the agent is picking up phantom tasks from system prompt context rather than user instructions.

Agent fails to connect to MCP server after restart
signals.review_reason: Main workflow is completely blocked after environment changes. The agent terminates because it cannot connect to the internal MCP server, making the entire sandbox unusable. This is a primary flow failure requiring manual intervention, not just a UX annoyance.

signals.topic: LLM cost tracking stops after session resume — accumulated_cost and costs[] freeze at pre-resume values
signals.summary: After resuming a conversation from saved state, all LLM costs stop being tracked. The restore_metrics() function updates llm._metrics but not llm._telemetry.metrics, causing new costs to be written to the wrong Metrics object. Cost tracking accuracy drops to 1.8% post-resume, leading to severely inaccurate billing reports.
aliases: Cost tracking accuracy drops to 1.8% after session resume
signals.review_reason: Direct cost loss for users who monitor LLM spending. Tracking accuracy drops to 1.8% post-resume, causing billing to be severely underestimated. Quantified with real trial data showing ~$0.48 reported vs actual cost being orders of magnitude higher. Users making billing decisions based on these numbers will significantly overprovision or underpay.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: LLM cost tracking stops after session resume — Telemetry.metrics not updated in restore_metrics
source_issues.evidence: Real trial data: go-zero repo (1 resumed session) tracked 45 LLM calls out of ~2,494 actual calls (1.8% accuracy), reporting $0.48 vs actual cost. ripgrep repo (3 new sessions, no resume) tracked 2,397 of ~3,104 calls (77.2% accuracy), reporting $24.29. Root cause: llm.restore_metrics() updates self._metrics but not self._telemetry.metrics. Bug present on latest main branch (1.16.1).

These failures block distinct core workflows (video, publishing, email, conversation) that users depend on for autonomous task completion.

signals.topic: OpenRouterResponses injects additionalProperties:false causing xAI/Grok HTTP 400 on structured output

aliases: OpenRouter schema injection blocking non-OpenAI providers
signals.review_reason: This is a real workflow runtime bug that causes API-level failures (HTTP 400) for structured outputs when using xAI/Grok through OpenRouter. The root cause (unconditional schema sanitization) is clearly identified with multiple code paths. While count=1, the impact is a complete block on structured output with affected providers, which qualifies as P1 (non-blocking for other providers but clearly impactful).

signals.topic: TeamSession.from_dict() mutates immutable SQLAlchemy RowMapping causing TypeError on SingleStore read
signals.summary: TeamSession.from_dict() assigns to data['summary'] which mutates the input Mapping. When reading from SingleStore, the reader passes row._mapping which is an immutable SQLAlchemy RowMapping. If a team session has a non-null summary dict, deserialization raises TypeError instead of returning the session.
aliases: SingleStore TeamSession immutable RowMapping mutation TypeError
TeamSession deserialization crashes on non-null summary from SingleStore
signals.review_reason: Confirmed crash on SingleStore read path: TeamSession deserialization fails with TypeError whenever the stored summary is non-null. This blocks the entire SingleStore team session read workflow. Root cause (mutation of immutable input) and fix (use local variable like AgentSession.from_dict() does) are clearly identified.

source_issues.title: SingleStore team-session reads crash when a stored summary is present
source_issues.evidence: TypeError raised when reading any TeamSession row with a non-null summary from SingleStore. Root cause: row._mapping (immutable) passed to TeamSession.from_dict() which mutates data['summary']. Found via code audit, validated with source-level analysis.

signals.topic: Qdrant hybrid search always instantiates FastEmbed BM25 sparse encoder even when embedder provides native sparse vectors
signals.summary: Qdrant hybrid search always triggers FastEmbed BM25 initialization regardless of whether the configured embedder already provides sparse vectors natively (e.g., bge-m3). This causes unnecessary FastEmbed dependency and ImportError when FastEmbed is not installed, even with embedders that natively support sparse output.
aliases: Qdrant hybrid search FastEmbed dependency not skipped for native sparse embedders
bge-m3 sparse vector native support ignored by Qdrant hybrid search
signals.review_reason: This causes ImportError that blocks hybrid search functionality, with clear user impact (unnecessary dependency + crash for users with native sparse embedders). While count=1, the duck-typing fix is straightforward and well-identified. Marked P2 as it is specific to hybrid search path with custom embedders.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Qdrant hybrid search always instantiates BM25 sparse encoder even when embedder provides native sparse vectors
source_issues.evidence: ImportError: 'To use keyword/hybrid search, install the fastembed extra' raised when using Qdrant with hybrid search and bge-m3 embedder that natively provides sparse vectors via get_sparse_embedding(). FastEmbed becomes mandatory dependency even when not needed.

signals.topic: Session export produces JSON that import cannot read (schema mismatch on legacy data shapes)
signals.summary: opencode export writes session JSON containing legacy pre-1.4 data shapes (e.g., messages[].info.variant instead of messages[].info.model.variant, summary.diffs[].before/after without patch field), but opencode import validates strictly against the 1.4 schema and rejects the file with 'expected string, received undefined' errors. The roundtrip is broken in both directions — re-export after import still produces legacy shapes, meaning import success does not normalize stored data permanently.
signals.review_reason: Session export/import roundtrip is a core data portability feature that is broken. Users cannot reliably back up or restore sessions, which blocks the primary workflow of preserving conversation history across reinstalls or machines.

source_issues.title: opencode export can write session JSON that opencode import cannot read in 1.4.3
source_issues.evidence: Export produces JSON with undefined patch field; import rejects with 'expected string, received undefined' at path summary.diffs[0].patch. Legacy variant fields (53 instances) and diff entries (73 instances) survive re-export after import, proving import does not normalize stored data.

signals.topic: opentui crashes on startup with TypeError (Object.entries on null/undefined)
signals.summary: After installing OpenCode via Homebrew and launching opentui, the application crashes immediately with 'TypeError: Object.entries requires that input parameter not be null or undefined' at mcp (bundled index.js). This is a startup crash that fully blocks usage for affected users.
signals.review_reason: Startup crash is a primary-flow blocker. Users who install via brew and launch opentui cannot use the application at all. This is reproducible on a fresh install and blocks the main entry point.

source_issues.title: opentui: fatal: Object.entries requires that input parameter not be null or undefined
source_issues.evidence: Fresh install via brew; crash occurs immediately on launch with full TypeError stack trace at Object.entries in bundled mcp module. Bug label confirms severity.

signals.topic: Azure GPT-5 model integration fails with syntax error in v1.4.3
signals.summary: When a GPT-5 model deployed on Azure is configured as an OpenAI-compatible provider in opencode, calling the model produces a syntax error that prevents any interaction. The bug is reproducible on Windows 11 WSL.
signals.review_reason: Azure GPT-5 is a major provider/model combination that fails completely. Users who have deployed GPT-5 on Azure cannot use it through opencode at all, which blocks the primary workflow of AI-assisted coding on a supported platform.

source_issues.title: bug: calling gpt5 with Azure not working due to systax error
source_issues.evidence: User deployed GPT-5 to Azure, configured opencode to use the model, and observing errors on every model call. Reproducible steps provided: deploy -> configure -> call -> error.

signals.topic: ACP message duplication on Windows (VSCode, Zed, JetBrains)
signals.summary: When connected to code editors via opencode acp on Windows, sending a message causes either request or response duplication. The duplication manifests differently per editor: VSCode ACP extension shows duplicated responses, Zed Editor shows duplicated requests, JetBrains prepends duplicated request to response. Other ACPs (Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) do not exhibit this, confirming the bug is in opencode.
signals.review_reason: ACP integration with code editors is a primary workflow on Windows. Message duplication breaks the editor integration for any user relying on opencode within their IDE, and the inconsistency across editors indicates a systemic ACP implementation bug.

source_issues.title: ACP: messages are duplicated
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed across three editors (VSCode, Zed, JetBrains) on Windows 11; other ACP tools do not duplicate. Screenshots provided showing duplication patterns. Bug label confirmed.

signals.topic: AI edit tool strips TypeScript generic type parameters from code
signals.summary: Every time the AI edits a TypeScript file containing generic type parameters (e.g., <ProductShowcaseRecord & { _id: string }>, GetStaticProps<T>, ObjectTypeParser<T, U, V>), it silently removes the generic arguments, leaving only the base type name. Once stripped, asking the AI to restore them fails — the AI repeatedly attempts edits that do nothing, and the code remains broken. All models exhibit this behavior.
signals.review_reason: This is a complete corruption of a core workflow: the edit tool silently destroys TypeScript type information on every edit. The resulting code is broken, non-compilable, and the AI cannot self-correct the damage. This is the most severe code-quality impact in the dataset — it makes the edit tool actively dangerous for TypeScript projects.

source_issues.title: When AI edit a file it strips all generics in TS
source_issues.evidence: User provided three concrete diffs showing generic type parameters removed from code. Screenshot of AI failing to restore them (repeated failed attempts) confirms the issue cannot be self-healed by the user.

signals.topic: BetaManagedAgentsEventParamsOfUserMessage helper omits required Type field causing 400 Bad Request on POST /v1/sessions/{id}/events
signals.summary: The helper function BetaManagedAgentsEventParamsOfUserMessage() does not set the required Type field, causing all calls using this helper to fail with '400 Bad Request: events[0].type: Field required'. Users must manually construct the struct as a workaround.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：使用BetaManagedAgentsEventParamsOfUserMessage helper的所有用户调用都会失败，返回明确的400错误。API核心功能不可用，且用户被迫绕过SDK helper直接构造struct，体验显著下降。

source_issues.title: BetaManagedAgentsEventParamsOfUserMessage helper omits required Type field
source_issues.evidence: API调用直接返回400 Bad Request，错误信息明确：'events[0].type: Field required'。根因是helper函数未设置必需字段。用户只能手动构造struct作为临时方案。

signals.topic: Streaming response JSON marshal error when max_tokens triggers mid tool-call
signals.summary: During streaming responses, when max_tokens limit is hit in the middle of a tool call, the SDK throws 'json: error calling MarshalJSON for type json.RawMessage: unexpected end of JSON input', breaking the streaming flow.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：streaming是核心功能路径，当max_tokens触发时产生未捕获的JSON marshal异常，导致streaming流程崩溃。用户无法正常使用流式响应，这是一个明确的运行时错误。

source_issues.title: Streaming: json: error calling MarshalJSON for type json.RawMessage: unexpected end of JSON input
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告在v1.26.0中，当max_tokens在tool call中间触发时，streaming流程直接抛出JSON marshal异常，导致流式响应流程崩溃。

signals.topic: SDK tests fail to compile on i386 (32-bit) architecture due to integer overflow in test constants
signals.summary: Test files contain a large integer constant (237628372683) used in struct literals that overflows int on 32-bit platforms, causing compilation failures for i386 architecture packages.
signals.review_reason: 构建失败影响特定架构用户：i386（32位）用户在编译和打包SDK时遇到明确的int overflow编译错误，导致测试无法通过。虽然非主流架构，但明确属于构建阻断问题，影响该平台上的开发体验。

source_issues.title: Tests fail on i386 (32 bit)
source_issues.evidence: Debian i386构建失败，错误为'int overflow'，影响使用该架构的用户正常编译和打包SDK。

signals.topic: Gift subscription automatically canceled or not applied due to Stripe $0.00 proration logic on 100% discount coupons
signals.summary: Gift subscriptions redeemed via 100% discount coupon are automatically canceled by Stripe's proration logic, reverting users to Free plan with no resolution path.
signals.review_reason: Main flow failure + cost loss: users paid for Max 5x gift subscriptions (~$100 value) but Stripe's $0.00 proration logic on 100% discount coupons automatically cancels the subscription, reverting accounts to Free plan. Both affected users have no resolution path — Fin AI Agent support loops indefinitely and cannot escalate to human agents. Cross-referenced with anthropics/claude-code#41499 confirming the same Stripe root cause. This is not a one-off: the same pattern appears in 2 separate issues filed independently, indicating a systemic billing bug affecting all gift subscription users.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Claude Max 5x gift subscription automatically canceled — account reverted to Free plan
source_issues.evidence: Gift subscription worked for 2 days then automatically canceled with no user action. Stripe $0.00 proration on 100% discount coupons cancels the subscription. User cannot re-subscribe (asks for £90), cannot re-redeem (already redeemed), and Fin AI Agent support loops indefinitely with no human escalation path.

source_issues.title: Gift subscription redeemed but account stuck on Free plan – no human support available
source_issues.evidence: Gift subscription redeemed but Max plan never applied. 7+ days of paid Max plan access lost. Support channels unavailable (blank page, AI bot cannot escalate). No resolution path.

signals.topic: Prompt caching disabled when streaming is enabled — cache tokens always null
signals.summary: When streaming=true, cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens are always null, making prompt caching completely unavailable for streaming use cases and causing significant token cost waste.
signals.review_reason: Key feature unavailable + cost loss: when streaming=true, both cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens are always null. This forces users to choose between streaming and prompt caching, a core cost optimization feature. Issue 1343 closed (likely resolved on backend) but issue 994 remains open, indicating the problem may not be fully resolved from the SDK side. Users who rely on streaming (real-time applications, long responses) cannot benefit from the significant cost savings of prompt caching.

source_issues.title: Caching does not work or not return cache info when streaming is enabled
source_issues.evidence: cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens are null when streaming=true. Prompt caching is entirely unavailable in streaming mode, forcing users to choose between streaming functionality and cost efficiency.

source_issues.title: Caching does not work or not return cache info when streaming is enabled
source_issues.evidence: Same issue: cache tokens are null when streaming is enabled, preventing prompt caching in streaming workflows.

signals.topic: Managed Agents streaming silently drops all events — events.stream() yields zero events
signals.summary: client.beta.sessions.events.stream() silently drops all events from managed agents because the Stream class only matches Messages API event names, while managed agents use different event names like session.status_started and agent.message.
signals.review_reason: Key feature unavailable: every consumer of streaming managed agents is affected — the events.stream() method silently drops all events with no error or warning because the Stream class only matches Messages API event names. This means streaming managed agents (a core feature) is entirely non-functional in SDK 0.93.0. Users receive zero events and have no indication why. This is a silent failure that breaks the entire streaming workflow for managed agents.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Managed Agents: client.beta.sessions.events.stream() silently drops all events
source_issues.evidence: client.beta.sessions.events.stream() yields 0 events out of 3 sent events. The Stream class is hardcoded to match only Messages API event names (content_block_delta, message_stop, etc.). Managed agents events (session.status_started, agent.message, etc.) have different names and are silently dropped with no error. Entirely broken in SDK version 0.93.0.

signals.topic: Custom skills in container parameter break message-level prompt caching — cache reads zero tokens on turn 2+
signals.summary: When custom skills are included in a container parameter, message-level prompt caching fails silently: cache_read_input_tokens=0 on subsequent turns despite consistent skills list, causing non-deterministic cache prefix and significant token cost waste.
aliases: Skills container breaks cache read tokens
signals.review_reason: Main flow failure + cost loss: users with custom skills in the container parameter cannot benefit from message-level prompt caching. Turn 2 shows 0 cache read tokens despite an identical, consistent skills list that should cache ~37k tokens. This causes non-deterministic cache prefixes, making multi-turn conversations with custom skills significantly more expensive. The user must choose between using custom skills (core feature) and cost efficiency.

source_issues.title: Custom skills in container parameter break prompt caching - consistent skills list produces non-deterministic cache prefix
source_issues.evidence: With custom skills in container parameter, Turn 2 shows cache_read_input_tokens=0 when it should read ~37k tokens from cache. Skills list is identical between turns, yet cache prefix changes non-deterministically, breaking the message-level caching optimization. Users with custom skills cannot benefit from prompt caching at all.

signals.topic: Claude Code CLI model alias mappings point to invalid model IDs — CLI completely non-functional
signals.summary: Model aliases like 'sonnet' and 'opus' in Claude Code CLI map to invalid model IDs (e.g., 'claude-sonnet-4-6' instead of 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022'), making the CLI completely non-functional without manual model ID specification.
aliases: Claude Code CLI broken model aliases
signals.review_reason: Main flow failure + blocking: Claude Code CLI is completely non-functional when using model aliases. The alias-to-model-ID mapping produces invalid model IDs, so the CLI fails on every invocation that uses shorthand aliases. Users must specify the full model ID every time, which is a significant UX regression from the expected shorthand behavior.

source_issues.title: There's an issue with the selected model (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022). It may not exist or you may not have access to it.
source_issues.evidence: Claude Code CLI with model aliases like 'sonnet' or 'opus' fails with 'model may not exist or you may not have access'. Aliases map to invalid model IDs (e.g., 'claude-sonnet-4-6' instead of 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022'). CLI is completely non-functional without specifying the full valid model ID. Breaks backward compatibility.

signals.topic: partialParse crashes entire MessageStream when model outputs invalid JSON escape sequences (e.g. PHP namespaces)
signals.summary: The partialParse function in _vendor/partial-json-parser throws 'Bad escaped character in JSON' when models emit tool call JSON containing unescaped backslashes from strings like PHP namespaces (App\Http\Middleware). This crashes MessageStream during input_json_delta accumulation, killing the entire SSE streaming response with no fallback.
aliases: MessageStream crash on PHP namespace backslashes
streaming response killed by invalid JSON escape sequences
signals.review_reason: 用户主流程阻断: MessageStream SSE streaming是SDK的核心功能，partialParse崩溃导致整个流式响应被杀死且无任何降级处理。已提供完整复现步骤(root cause定位到generate()函数未做字符串转义修复)，影响所有使用MessageStream处理模型工具调用输出的用户。count=1未达P0阈值，但影响明确且严重，标记P1。

source_issues.title: partialParse in _vendor/partial-json-parser crashes on invalid JSON escape sequences from model output
source_issues.evidence: partialParse throws 'Bad escaped character in JSON at position 80' when parsing tool call JSON with PHP namespace backslashes like 'App\Http\Middleware\HandleAppearance'. This crashes MessageStream at line 501 during input_json_delta accumulation, killing the entire SSE streaming response. No try/catch fallback exists. Reproduction provided with exact input string.

signals.topic: setting_sources=[] (empty list) silently ignored due to Python truthiness check — users cannot disable setting sources
signals.summary: When setting_sources=[] is passed to ClaudeAgentOptions, it is silently ignored because the SDK checks `if self._options.setting_sources:` instead of `if self._options.setting_sources is not None:`. An empty list is falsy, so --setting-sources is never passed to the CLI, causing all setting sources (including account-level MCP integrations) to load unexpectedly. This is the same class of bug as allowed_tools=[] (issue #634).
signals.review_reason: This is a confirmed bug where the explicit intent of setting_sources=[] (disable all settings) is silently ignored, causing unexpected account-level MCP integrations to load. Two independent reports confirm the issue. The workaround (passing ['']) is non-obvious. While it doesn't crash, it silently breaks user expectations in a security-sensitive context (account-level integrations loading without consent).

source_issues.title: setting_sources=[] (empty list) silently ignored — global settings always loaded
source_issues.evidence: ClaudeAgentOptions(setting_sources=[]) has no effect. Truthiness test `if self._options.setting_sources:` treats [] as falsy, so --setting-sources is never passed. CLI falls back to loading all sources including account-level claude.ai MCP integrations.

source_issues.title: setting_sources=[] silently ignored due to truthiness check in _build_command
source_issues.evidence: Explicitly documents the same truthiness check bug in subprocess_cli.py line 283. Notes that allowed_tools=[] was fixed for the same class of bug (issue #634). Workaround of setting_sources=[''] is fragile.

signals.topic: ProcessError exit_code and stderr stripped during exception propagation — CLI subprocess errors become untyped generic Exception with placeholder string
signals.summary: When the Claude CLI subprocess exits non-zero, the SDK creates a ProcessError but then destroys all structured error context through a three-step chain: (1) subprocess_cli.py creates ProcessError with hardcoded stderr='Check stderr output for details' instead of actual output; (2) query.py flattens it via str(e), losing exit_code and stderr attributes; (3) receive_messages() re-raises as bare Exception. Users cannot catch ProcessError, cannot access exit_code, cannot get actual stderr, and documented error-handling patterns (except ClaudeSDKError) don't work.
aliases: stderr='Check stderr output for details' placeholder
signals.review_reason: This is a main-flow-blocking error handling defect. When the CLI subprocess fails (common scenario: bad model alias, permission denied, internal error), users receive an untyped Exception with a hardcoded placeholder string and no actual diagnostic information. Documented exception-handling patterns (except ProcessError, except ClaudeSDKError) fail silently. The issue explicitly references three previously-closed issues (#515, #282, #238) showing this is a recurring pattern, not an isolated incident.

source_issues.title: ProcessError exit_code/stderr stripped during error propagation; users see generic Exception with hard-coded 'Check stderr output for details' placeholder
source_issues.evidence: Triple defect across three files. subprocess_cli.py hardcodes stderr='Check stderr output for details'. query.py flattens via str(e). receive_messages() raises bare Exception. Verified reproduction shows isinstance(exc, ProcessError)=False, exc.stderr=False, exc.exit_code=False. References closed issues #515, #282, #238 as additional variants of the same problem.

source_issues.title: Error context destroyed through exception flattening — CLI failures produce unhelpful 'Command failed with exit code 1'
source_issues.evidence: Same triple-defect chain documented from a different author's perspective. Confirms the hardcoded stderr placeholder, str(e) flattening, and bare Exception re-raise. Also identifies additional instances: bare Exception() at query.py lines 207-209, 272, 318, 334, 346, 385, 420; stderr reading exceptions silently swallowed at subprocess_cli.py lines 446-449; process.wait() failures caught as returncode=-1 with no logging.

signals.topic: Agent response undefined is not an object (evaluating '$.speed') — SDK crashes or produces malformed output
signals.summary: Users of claude-agent-sdk v0.1.56 encounter 'undefined is not an object (evaluating $.speed') errors in execution logs when using the SDK for coding agent workflows. Related to GitHub issues #40737 and #40189 in claude-code.
signals.review_reason: A JavaScript-level SDK crash occurring in user production runs with v0.1.56. While count=1, the linked upstream issues in claude-code suggest this is a broader pattern affecting SDK users. The error indicates a response parsing/malformation issue that can block agent workflows.

source_issues.title: Agent response undefined is not an object (evaluating '$.speed')
source_issues.evidence: SDK v0.1.56 users encounter 'undefined is not an object (evaluating $.speed') JavaScript error in execution logs. Explicitly linked to related claude-code issues #40737 and #40189 indicating a known upstream pattern.

signals.topic: receive_response() streams MCP tool results as UserMessage, causing agent infinite loops
signals.summary: When using create_sdk_mcp_server to register custom MCP tools, receive_response() streams MCP tool results as UserMessage containing ToolResultBlock. These are indistinguishable from real user messages without inspecting content blocks, causing the model to misinterpret tool results as new user input and trigger infinite agent loops. Requires elaborate workarounds (system prompt instructions, content validation, rate limiting).
aliases: MCP tool results cause infinite loop
signals.review_reason: While count=1, this is a significant agent workflow blocker. MCP tool integrations are a core use case for the SDK. The ambiguous message type causes infinite loops that waste API tokens and lose agent state. The workarounds require deep SDK knowledge and are fragile.

source_issues.title: receive_response() streams tool results as UserMessage, causing agent loops
source_issues.evidence: MCP tool results streamed as UserMessage with ToolResultBlock. Verified loop pattern: AssistantMessage (tool call) -> UserMessage (tool result) -> AssistantMessage (tool call again). Agent misinterprets tool results as requiring a response, re-calling the same tool. Workarounds (system prompt, content validation, rate limiting) are fragile defense-in-depth.

signals.topic: SendMessage tool hinted by CLI but not available in SDK — subagent results lost on token/turn limits
signals.summary: When a long-running subagent is cut off by token or turn limits, the CLI outputs an agentId hint suggesting the use of 'SendMessage' to continue the session. The parent agent then attempts to call SendMessage, which does not exist in the SDK toolset, causing a tool_use_error and entering a failure loop that loses the subagent's work.
aliases: agentId hint but no resume mechanism
signals.review_reason: Subagent workflow is a core SDK use case. When subagents are cut off by limits, the agent is instructed to use a non-existent tool, entering a failure loop. This causes data loss (subagent results) and wastes API calls. Workaround is essentially 'complete all work before limits' which is impractical for complex tasks.

source_issues.title: Bug: Long-running subagent returns agentId with SendMessage hint, but SendMessage tool does not exist
source_issues.evidence: Subagent hit by token/turn limits returns agentId hint referencing SendMessage. SDK toolset does not include SendMessage. Parent agent enters failure loop calling non-existent tool. Subagent's work (e.g., uploaded files) is lost. No documented resume mechanism exists.

signals.topic: Plugin initialization fails with control protocol timeout in SDK 0.1.45+
signals.summary: Plugin initialization causes a hard timeout error ("Control request timeout: initialize") in SDK versions 0.1.45 through 0.1.56. The control protocol initialization phase exceeds the hardcoded 65-second timeout, completely blocking the SDK from working with any plugin. Users must downgrade to 0.1.44 to unblock themselves.
aliases: Control request timeout during plugin init
signals.review_reason: Main flow blocker: plugin initialization is completely broken across 12+ consecutive SDK versions (0.1.45–0.1.56). The only resolution is downgrading, which means all plugin users are blocked. The 65-second hardcoded timeout in _send_control_request() is systematically exceeded during the control protocol initialization phase.

source_issues.title: Plugin initialization fails with "Control request timeout: initialize" error in claude-agent-sdk versions 0.1.45 and above. The timeout occurs after ~65 seconds during the SDK's control protocol initialization phase.
source_issues.evidence: SDK 0.1.45-0.1.56 all fail with timeout. Downgrading to 0.1.44 resolves. Full stack trace provided showing hardcoded 65s timeout exceeded. Plugin with zero files and single skill triggers the timeout.

signals.topic: outputFormat silently returns success with no structured_output for non-trivial JSON schemas
signals.summary: When using outputFormat with complex/nested JSON schemas, the SDK returns subtype 'success' but structured_output is undefined. The model produces correct JSON in the text result, but the SDK fails to extract or validate it and does not return error_max_structured_output_retries. Users receive a success signal with no usable structured data, causing silent failures in downstream processing.
aliases: outputFormat silently fails for nested schemas
signals.review_reason: Significant silent failure: users cannot rely on structured output for any non-trivial schema despite it being a core SDK feature. The SDK reports success while delivering no structured data, causing downstream processing to fail or receive undefined values without any error signal. The user must fall back to parsing raw text output manually.

source_issues.title: outputFormat returns subtype 'success' when structured_output is absent — should return error_max_structured_output_retries
source_issues.evidence: Detailed reproduction with simple schema (works) vs nested schema (fails). Model returns correct JSON in result text but SDK does not populate structured_output. All failing cases return subtype 'success' instead of error_max_structured_output_retries. Tested across multiple models (claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5).

signals.topic: Bun --compile build fails due to missing tempfile.js in published package
signals.summary: SDK 0.2.96 ships extractFromBunfs.js with an import of ./tempfile.js that does not exist in the npm artifact.
